description: UCI row 85 (age 29, MEDIUM vulnerability, moderate knowledge, RT 6, horizon 4yr) — em equity etf: all hard rules pass, soft fails ['R3'] (score 85) -> SUITABLE
client_narrative: Yuki Hashimoto is 29 years old. Their gross annual income is approximately 55,100 euros (around 4,592 euros per month). They hold 56,000 euros in liquid savings and wish to invest 1,800 euros with a 4-year investment horizon. In terms of financial background, the client has moderate investment experience, including equities, mutual funds, and standard bond instruments. Their investment approach is moderate — they rate their risk tolerance at 6 out of 10. They have confirmed they can afford to lose the entire 1,800 euros if the investment performs poorly. Their financial circumstances place them in the medium vulnerability category.
product_narrative: The product is a UCITS exchange-traded fund tracking the MSCI Emerging Markets Index, providing exposure to equity markets across 24 emerging-market countries. The fund publishes a KID, trades intraday on regulated exchanges, uses no leverage, and holds no embedded derivatives. It is classified NON-COMPLEX under MiFID II Article 25(4)(a). Due to elevated market and currency risk, moderate financial knowledge is expected from investors. The recommended minimum holding period is seven years.
